assets.subject: Sprout, a small round cream companion pet with two leaf ears
assets.details: A plump cream-white bean-shaped little creature with two fresh green leaf ears on top of its head, big happy closed eyes, rosy cheeks, tiny stubby arms, sitting and smiling. Simple and friendly, clearly a plant-sprout spirit, not a bunny or a cat.

assets.subject: a clay soup pot on a small round burner
assets.details: Glazed terracotta claypot with a lid slightly lifted, gentle white steam curling up, on a short black burner ring. Seen from the front at a slight angle.

assets.subject: a cute round cream electric rice cooker
assets.details: Rounded cream body with a sage-green lid and a small rice paddle resting on top, a soft steam wisp from the vent. Seen from the front at a slight angle. No words or letters.
